proof_body:
by
  intro m n hmn
  have key : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → (∫ x in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * x)) = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    have hk' : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (fun y => Real.cos y) hk', integral_cos]
    have h1 : Real.sin ((k : ℝ) * Real.pi) = 0 := Real.sin_int_mul_pi k
    have h2 : Real.sin ((k : ℝ) * -Real.pi) = 0 := by
      rw [mul_neg, Real.sin_neg, h1, neg_zero]
    rw [h1, h2]
    simp
  have hsub : ((m : ℤ) - n) ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hadd : ((m : ℤ) + n) ≠ 0 := by omega
  have e : ∀ x : ℝ, Real.cos (m * x) * Real.cos (n * x) = (Real.cos ((((m : ℤ) - n : ℤ) : ℝ) * x) + Real.cos ((((m : ℤ) + n : ℤ) : ℝ) * x)) / 2 := by
    intro x
    push_cast
    rw [sub_mul, add_mul, Real.cos_sub, Real.cos_add]
    ring
  simp_rw [e]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div, intervalIntegral.integral_add (Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _) (Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _), key _ hsub, key _ hadd]
  simp
target_source: ∀ (m n : ℕ), m ≠ n → (∫ x in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, Real.cos (m * x) * Real.cos (n * x)) = 0
